item.title: Art Models Struggle for a Living Wage and Recognition
item.description: The workers who pose for artists at historic organizations like the Art Students League say they are overworked and underpaid in a field that rarely values them.

item.title: The Plight of Art Models
item.description: Also: the troubling trend of "Crusadercore," pet monkeys in Ancient Rome, and what's really going on in those Vanity Fair photos of Trump's top advisors?

item.title: LSU School of Art Offers Highest MFA Stipends in the Southern US
item.description: With assistantships funded at $23,000, full tuition waivers, and generous health insurance, Louisiana State University helps students lay the groundwork for a successful lifelong art practice.

item.title: A View From the Easel
item.description: “Every day I see more and more of my footprint in this small space.”

item.title: Required Reading
item.description: Joan Mitchell and the written word, garments with passports, “The Voice of Hind Rajab,” Christmas book-gifting in Iceland, toppled Lady Liberty, and more.

item.title: Indigenous Glass Art Takes Center Stage at the National Museum of the American Indian
item.description: “Clearly Indigenous: Native Visions Reimagined in Glass” celebrates culture, craft, and storytelling. Now on view in New York City.

item.title: LACMA Workers Vote Overwhelmingly to Unionize
item.description: A whopping 96% of staff at the Los Angeles County Museum of Art voted in favor of a union, calling for higher pay and “increased transparency.”

item.title: Debt Plagues Artists Regardless of Career Stage, Survey Finds
item.description: Data compiled by artist mentor Paddy Johnson from over 1,000 respondents indicates that “artists across all levels struggle with a lot of the same things.”

item.title: The Best Art Shows Around the World in 2025
item.description: Nan Goldin’s fearless photos, Noah Davis’s enchantments of ordinary life, Stan Douglas’s historical visions, and Yoko Ono’s musical mind were just some of our favorites.

item.title: Art Movements: New York City's 27-Foot Buddha
item.description: Tuan Andrew Nguyen tapped for High Line commission, PAIN's Megan Kapler heads to Housing Works, the Whitney Biennial, and more.
